description: React component for an editable page with drag-and-drop blocks, handling block updates, deletions, and server synchronization.

methods.name: EditablePage
methods.description: React functional component managing editable page blocks with drag-and-drop, server updates, and focus handling.

methods.name: updatePageOnServer
methods.description: Async function to update page blocks on server via API call.

methods.name: deleteImageOnServer
methods.description: Async function to delete an image from server given its URL.

methods.name: updateBlockHandler
methods.description: Updates a specific block's data and deletes old image if changed.

methods.name: addBlockHandler
methods.description: Adds a new block after the current block.

methods.name: deleteBlockHandler
methods.description: Deletes a specified block and deletes its image if it's an image block.

methods.name: onDragEndHandler
methods.description: Handles reordering of blocks after drag-and-drop.
